title: Through the Wildgate
description: Walk through the Wildgate ring on the south islet.

giver.name: Hollis Barrowmead
giver.text: You've met everyone worth meeting. Now the best part. South of the village, on an islet of its own, stands the Wildgate, a great stone ring with a shimmering veil.

objectives.label: Step through the Wildgate into the survival world
